SK0059 देश deśa habitat, the place or environment where a plant or animal naturally or normally lives and grows
SV0080 देशविरुद्ध deśaviruddha Intake of dry and sharp substance in deserts: unctuous and cold substance in marshy land is considered as place unwholesome diet/ drugs.
DG0069 देश्योक्ति deśyokti habitat; plants are named on basis of their place of origin
